transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what brings me in is... I keep planning my days around not having to drive over high bridges. It's just getting to be a hassle. And if I absolutely can't find a way around it, I end up just white-knuckling it the whole way across. So, I figured it was time to come in and talk to someone about it.
Aside from high bridges, are there any other places or situations that you feel anxious about or tend to avoid?

No, not really. It's honestly just the high bridges. I don't have any issues with, you know, flying or being up in tall buildings or elevators or anything like that. It's specifically just being in the car and driving over a bridge that's way up in the air. That's really the only thing that gets to me.
